crossRefs.note: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

translations.web: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
translations.bsb: Proud beasts have never trodden it; no lion has ever prowled over it.
translations.kjv: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed
translations.asv: The proud beasts have not trodden it, Nor hath the fierce lion passed thereby.
